# The AI invents functions; the docs are the test {#sec-the-docs-are-the-test}

*The week-twelve AI beat, paired with the documentation lecture.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
Shows the assistant confidently calling a library function or an API endpoint that does not exist, one of its most common and most costly failures. Teaches that the real documentation is what the invented call fails against, and that reading a library or service as a catalogue of contracts is how you catch it. The verification principle applied to capability claims.
:::
